interface.longDescription:
Practice job interviews in ChatGPT, by typing or out loud in voice mode.

Share your resume and the job description, or just the role you're going for. ChatGPT runs a realistic mock interview, asking questions one at a time in a natural conversation. When you're done, MockPrep scores the whole interview out of 10 against the role and your background, with a score and feedback for each answer and the top things to work on.

You can also ask MockPrep for a set of practice questions, or paste a single answer to any interview question and get it scored.

Tip: upload your resume in a chat, then start voice mode and say "Interview me for this role, then have MockPrep score it."

MockPrep does not store your resume, job descriptions or answers.
